SELECT ?namedAfter ?namedAfterLabel (COUNT(?item) AS ?count) (SAMPLE(?itemLabel) AS ?example) WHERE {
  ?item wdt:[property:named after] ?namedAfter .
  ?item rdfs:label ?itemLabel .
  FILTER(LANG(?itemLabel) = "en")
  ?namedAfter rdfs:label ?namedAfterLabel .
  FILTER(LANG(?namedAfterLabel) = "en")
}
GROUP BY ?namedAfter ?namedAfterLabel
ORDER BY DESC(?count)
LIMIT 100

SELECT ?word (COUNT(?article) AS ?count) WHERE {
  ?article wdt:[property:instance of] wd:[entity:scholarly article] .
  ?article wdt:[property:title] ?title .
  BIND(STRLANG(?title, "en") AS ?titleEn)

}
GROUP BY ?word
ORDER BY DESC(?count)

SELECT ?saint ?saintLabel (COUNT(DISTINCT ?city) AS ?cityCount) WHERE {
  ?saint wdt:[property:instance of] wd:[entity:human] .
  ?saint wdt:[property:sex or gender] wd:[entity:male] .
  ?saint wdt:[property:religion or worldview] ?religion .
  ?saint wdt:[property:canonization status] ?status .
  ?city wdt:[property:country] wd:[entity:France] .

  SERVICE wikibase:label { bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "en". }
}
GROUP BY ?saint ?saintLabel

SELECT DISTINCT ?artist ?artistLabel WHERE {
  ?artist wdt:[property:occupation] wd:[entity:artist] .
  ?artist wdt:[property:date of birth] ?dob .
  ?artist wdt:[property:given name] ?givenName .
  ?artist wdt:[property:family name] ?familyName .
  ?givenName rdfs:label ?givenNameLabel .
  ?familyName rdfs:label ?familyNameLabel .
  FILTER(LANG(?givenNameLabel) = "en")
  FILTER(LANG(?familyNameLabel) = "en")
  FILTER(STRSTARTS(?givenNameLabel, "D"))
  FILTER(STRSTARTS(?familyNameLabel, "K"))
  FILTER(YEAR(?dob) >= 1880 && YEAR(?dob) <= 1944)
  SERVICE wikibase:label { bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "en". }
}

SELECT ?country ?countryLabel (COUNT(DISTINCT ?person) AS ?count) WHERE {
  ?person wdt:[property:instance of] wd:[entity:human] .
  ?person wdt:[property:place of birth] ?place .
  ?place wdt:[property:country] ?country .
  ?person wdt:[property:given name] ?name .
  ?name rdfs:label ?nameLabel .
  FILTER(LANG(?nameLabel) = "en")
  FILTER(STRSTARTS(?nameLabel, "Q") || STRSTARTS(?nameLabel, "X"))
  SERVICE wikibase:label { bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "en". }
}
GROUP BY ?country ?countryLabel
ORDER BY DESC(?count)
LIMIT 20

SELECT DISTINCT ?country ?countryLabel ?isoCode WHERE {
  ?country wdt:[property:instance of] wd:[entity:sovereign state] .
  ?country wdt:[property:continent] wd:[entity:Europe] .
  ?country wdt:[property:ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code] ?isoCode .
  ?country rdfs:label ?nativeName .
  ?country wdt:[property:official language] ?lang .
  ?lang wdt:[property:Wikimedia language code] ?langCode .
  FILTER(LANG(?nativeName) = ?langCode)
  FILTER(
    CONTAINS(UCASE(?nativeName), SUBSTR(?isoCode, 1, 1)) = false ||
    CONTAINS(UCASE(?nativeName), SUBSTR(?isoCode, 2, 1)) = false
  )
  SERVICE wikibase:label { bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "en" . }
}

SELECT ?municipality ?municipalityLabel ?city1 ?city1Label ?city2 ?city2Label ?distance WHERE {
  ?city1 wdt:[property:instance of] wd:[entity:city] .
  ?city1 wdt:[property:located in the administrative territorial entity] ?municipality .
  ?municipality wdt:[property:instance of] wd:[entity:municipality] .
  ?city2 wdt:[property:instance of] wd:[entity:city] .
  ?city2 wdt:[property:located in the administrative territorial entity] ?municipality .
  ?city1 wdt:[property:coordinate location] ?coord1 .
  ?city2 wdt:[property:coordinate location] ?coord2 .
  FILTER(?city1 != ?city2)
  BIND(geof:distance(?coord1, ?coord2) AS ?distance)
  SERVICE wikibase:label { bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "en". }
}
ORDER BY ?municipalityLabel ?distance

  ?museum wdt:[property:coordinate location] ?museumCoord .

  ?artwork wdt:[property:creator] ?artist .
  ?artist wdt:[property:place of birth] ?birthplace .
  ?birthplace wdt:[property:coordinate location] ?birthCoord .

}

  ?place wdt:[property:located in the administrative territorial entity] wd:[entity:Oxford] .
  ?place wdt:[property:coordinate location] ?coord .
  ?place wdt:[property:instance of] ?type .
  BIND(
    IF(?type = wd:[entity:university], "0000FF",
    IF(?type = wd:[entity:museum], "FF0000",
    IF(?type = wd:[entity:church building], "00FF00",
    IF(?type = wd:[entity:library], "FFFF00",
    IF(?type = wd:[entity:park], "FF00FF",
    "808080"))))) AS ?rgb
  )
  SERVICE wikibase:label { bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "en". }
}

SELECT ?dayOfWeek (COUNT(?person) AS ?count) WHERE {
  ?person wdt:[property:place of death] wd:[entity:Mauthausen concentration camp] .
  ?person wdt:[property:date of death] ?date .
  BIND(
    (((DAY(?date) + 
      FLOOR(2.6 * (((MONTH(?date) + 9) % 12) + 1) - 0.2) - 
      2 * (YEAR(?date) - FLOOR((((MONTH(?date) + 9) % 12) / 10)) % 100 / 100) + 
      (YEAR(?date) - FLOOR((((MONTH(?date) + 9) % 12) / 10)) % 100) + 
      FLOOR((YEAR(?date) - FLOOR((((MONTH(?date) + 9) % 12) / 10)) % 100) / 4) + 
      FLOOR(FLOOR((YEAR(?date) - FLOOR((((MONTH(?date) + 9) % 12) / 10)) / 100)) / 4) - 
      2 * FLOOR((YEAR(?date) - FLOOR((((MONTH(?date) + 9) % 12) / 10)) / 100))) % 7) + 7) % 7 
    AS ?dayOfWeek
  )
}
GROUP BY ?dayOfWeek
ORDER BY DESC(?count)
LIMIT 1

SELECT (MIN(?age) AS ?youngestAge) WHERE {
  ?person wdt:[property:position held] ?statement .
  ?person p:[property:position held] ?ps .
  ?ps ps:[property:position held] wd:[entity:Member of Parliament of the United Kingdom] .
  ?ps pq:[property:end time] ?endTime .
  ?person wdt:[property:date of birth] ?dob .
  FILTER(YEAR(?endTime) >= 1900)
  BIND((?endTime - ?dob) / 365.25 AS ?age)
}
